thread.title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Fall On Trump Tariff Talk; Marijuana Stocks Hit

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Fall On Trump Tariff Talk; Marijuana Stocks Hit
text:
The Dow Jones and S&P 500 worsened in the stock market today on reports President Donald Trump is ready to move forward with an additional $200 billion in proposed tariffs on Chinese goods.
X Meanwhile, marijuana stocks took heat after short-seller Citron Research took a shot at Cronos Group ( CRON ), questioning the size of its distribution agreements with provinces. Shares of Cronos Group crashed 24%; Canopy Growth ( CGC ) lost 5% and Tilray ( TLRY ), which reported strong sales earlier this week, gave back 7%.
In late afternoon trading, the Dow Jones industrial average was down 0.6% and the S&P 500 lost 0.5%. The Nasdaq composite gave back around 0.3%. Volume on the NYSE and Nasdaq was tracking slightly higher than Wednesday's levels. Major stock indexes held up relatively well even as the Argentine peso crashed to record lows over concerns Argentina could default as it struggles to repay debt. The country on Wednesday asked for an early release of a $50 billion loan from the International Monetary Fund.
WTI crude oil futures settled at $70.25 a barrel, up 1.1%. It's the first close above $70 a barrel this month.
In stock market results today , Apple ( AAPL ) was the Dow's top gainer, up more than 1%, after the company announced a Sept. 12 event — most likely to reveal its latest iPhones. It's too late to buy shares, though, after the tech bellwether gapped out of a flat base on Aug. 1.
Stock Market Today: Retail Earnings Flow Continues Once again, earnings reports in the retail sector dominated the headlines. Abercrombie & Fitch ( ANF ), Burlington Stores ( BURL ), Dollar General ( DG ) and Dollar Tree ( DLTR ) fell hard on lackluster results. Earnings winners included Guess ( GES ) and Signet Jewelers ( SIG ). Guess gapped up over a 26.25 buy point earlier in the session, but the stock ceded early gains.
After the close, watch for earnings reports from Leaderboard name Lululemon Athletica ( LULU ) and Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ).
Inside the MarketSmith Growth 250 , small cap Tilly's ( TLYS ) soared more than 12% on strong earnings, but it was already too extended after a breakout from a consolidation in early June.
In the semiconductor space, Semtech ( SMTC ) gapped up over a 52 buy point on strong earnings. Shares were up 13% to 56.45. Semtech's chip designer industry group is back near highs after rising for eight straight sessions. The group was up another 0.5% Thursday.
Inside the IBD 50 , Abiomed ( ABMD ) drew closer to a 436.52 double-bottom entry. Shares rose nearly 3% to 413.45. Elsewhere, World Wrestling Entertainment ( WWE ), featured in Wednesday's IBD 50 Stock Of The Day , added 0.5% to 86.36. It's still in buy range from an 86.03 flat-base entry, but it's been a low-volume breakout so far.
